## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: When this story is complete, `grep -n 'rule_id' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md` returns lines documenting the new optional field with a description and example.
- dd-2: When this story is complete, all existing reviewer-findings.json fixtures in the repo validate against the updated schema without modification.
- dd-3: When this story is complete, the schema explicitly marks `rule_id` as optional and documents its absence as semantically equivalent to no rule attribution.

## Implementation Notes

### reviewer-base.md edit
Edit `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md` to add an optional `rule_id` field to the reviewer-findings.json schema documentation. The current schema documents these finding-level fields: severity, category, description, file, cited_lines, cited_excerpt, verification_evidence, reachability. Add `rule_id` with:

1. Type: string
2. Optionality: explicitly marked as optional (not required)
3. Description: stable rule identifier for cross-tool attribution (LAURA, replay-regression-harness will use this as a join key)
4. Absence semantics: when `rule_id` is absent, the finding has no rule attribution — semantically equivalent to a finding not tied to a named rule
5. Example: at least one example value in the JSON block (e.g., `"rule_id": "hygiene-pyupgrade-needs-iso"`)

Update both the example JSON block (around lines 184-194) and the per-field description section that follows.

### dd-2 satisfied by construction (not by runtime fixture test)
The non-breaking guarantee holds structurally because:
- `rule_id` is documented as OPTIONAL — existing fixtures without it remain conformant
- This task does NOT modify `plugins/dso/scripts/validate-review-output.sh` — the runtime validator is unchanged, so any fixture passing validation today continues to pass tomorrow
- `validate-review-output.sh` enforces an allowlist only on top-level keys (findings, summary, review_tier, selected_tier, escalate_review, scores); there is NO per-finding field allowlist, so adding an optional field to docs cannot invalidate any existing fixture

AC-7 below is therefore a structural check: confirm `validate-review-output.sh` is unchanged. This proves dd-2 directly without depending on which fixtures happen to exist or their internal validity for unrelated reasons.

### Scope guardrails
- IN scope: `reviewer-base.md` edit only (per story IN scope)
- OUT of scope (per story): populating rule_id in actual reviewer agents; downstream consumer logic
- DEFERRED follow-on (explicit): `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md` has a peer Field Definitions table that should eventually document rule_id for consistency. Intentionally NOT included in this story to keep scope aligned with the ticket. File a follow-on story if needed.

### Testing mode rationale
GREEN. Per behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5, instruction files (prompts read by sub-agents) cannot be deterministically tested for behavioral correctness — the LLM consumes them probabilistically. Verification relies on grep-based presence checks of the documented field plus a structural check that the validator is unchanged. No RED unit test required.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] rule_id documented with description and example in reviewer-base.md (dd-1)
  Verify: grep -cE 'rule_id' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md | awk '{ if ($1 >= 2) exit 0; else exit 1 }'
- [ ] rule_id marked optional in reviewer-base.md (dd-3 optionality)
  Verify: grep -nE 'rule_id.*optional|optional.*rule_id|\(optional\)' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
- [ ] Absence semantics documented in reviewer-base.md (dd-3 absence)
  Verify: grep -n 'rule_id' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md | grep -iE 'absent|absence|omitted|no rule attribution|when.*(not|missing)'
- [ ] validate-review-output.sh is unchanged — proving dd-2 by construction (combined with the rule_id-optional AC, existing fixtures need no modification)
  Verify: ! git diff --name-only HEAD -- plugins/dso/scripts/validate-review-output.sh | grep -q .
- [ ] Scope guardrail: no changes to any file other than reviewer-base.md
  Verify: ! git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -vE '^plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base\.md$' | grep -q .

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Escalation Policy
Escalation policy: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Document optional rule_id field in reviewer-base.md schema
